description: Question set for the SYNTHETIC sample paper in evals/sample/ (all of its content is invented). Use it to check that the evaluation scripts run; write or generate a set for your own paper to get meaningful numbers. expected_facts are short exact strings a correct answer must contain; answerable=false questions test that the system says the paper does not cover them.
